thread:
anya: Postmortem follow-up: we need owners and dates for remediation and for the test additions we promised (regression suite updates, incident prompt sets, targeted load tests, and a short chaos drill). I want items entered in the remediation board today.

vasu: I can take the regression updates. Plan: add the 12 failing prompts into nightly-fast and create nightly-longseq for the 3 long-context failures. I'll open a GH PR by Tue COB.

mel: I'll own the incident prompt curation. Extraction + labels (severity, expected snippet, notes). Format: csv with id,input,expected,severity. Uploading to evals/incident-sets and filing an evals issue. ETA Thu EOD.

ryan: I'll handle the targeted load test to reproduce the resource spike pattern. Need CAP for 2 sandbox nodes tuned for eviction. If CAP created today I can run the test Mon morning.

ops-bot: Reminder: add SLO thresholds and rollback criteria to the drill playbook (p95 latency, error rate, fallback success rate).

anya: Vasu, Mel, Ryan 99please paste GH/ticket links here when created. I'll add a recurring "incident-driven evals" card to the remediation board and schedule a 30m post-drill validation sync.

vasu: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/5301 9includes regression additions and harness flag to tag incident severity.

mel: Uploaded CSV: evals/incident-sets/INC-2049.csv and issue: https://github.com/redwood/evals/issues/105

ryan: CAP-2180 created: https://tracker.redwood.ai/CAP-2180 92 sandbox nodes requested. Scheduled load run Mon 08:30 PT.

eng-ml-bot: Note: please mark high-severity prompts as gating in the harness so canary fails on regressions.

anya: Timelines recap: vasu PR Tue COB, mel CSV Thu EOD, ryan load test Mon 08:30 PT. I'll move these to remediation board and add owners. If anything slips, update the cards.

vasu: I'll include a short test plan in the PR and a checklist for the reviewer.

mel: Adding expected-snippet annotations to make false positives rarer.

ryan: Will post load test logs to the ticket and tag eng-sre for monitoring.

anya: Thanks all. After the run we'll validate regressions, and close items in the board. Posting this into the postmortem doc now. :thumbsup:
